newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB unit to offer 50 bln yen of 3-yr Euroyen bonds.
newsitem.headline: NCB unit to offer 50 bln yen of 3-yr Euroyen bonds.

text.p: An overseas subsidiary of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) is planning to offer 50 billion yen worth of three-year floating-rate Euroyen bonds in the near future, an NCB official said on Friday.
The issue by the subsidiary, Nippon Credit Bank (Curacao) Finance NV, is expected to be priced at about 50 basis points over the three- or six-month yen LIBOR, the official said.
He said the bonds would be launched shortly, but was unsure of the exact timing.
"They will be launched in the near future, but not likely today," he said.
The payment date will be around the end of July and maturity will be in July 2000. The issue will be lead-managed by Bankers Trust International Plc and guaranteed by NCB.
In April, Nippon Credit Bank signed a business agreement with Bankers Trust to securitise its real estate and other assets.
